notes: Counts: 7 program-list, 0 single-record, 18 not-a-list. Institutions by host were kept for every page. The four University of Lausanne pages are two pages each captured under two hosts (cec.cms.unil.ch and ircm.cms.unil.ch) with identical text; integrate one copy of each. The Lausanne placements page gives current positions in alumni testimonials (one alumnus says his first appointment was at the University of Amsterdam), so it supports current affiliation, not first job, and it has no graduation years. The Rady, UGA and IEOR lists are small (three, three and one names) with no placements; the IEOR page is one advisor's slice of the department dissertation list. Three news items were classed not-a-list per the brief but each states one named person's doctoral placement that could serve as single-person evidence: UCSB Technology Management (Virginia Leavell, assistant professor, Cambridge Judge, Ph.D. expected June 2022), UF ISOM (Hong Guo, Ph.D. 2009, assistant professor at Notre Dame as of Dec 2009) and UF ISOM (Hongseok Jang, Ph.D. 2021, assistant professor of management science at Tulane). The two Cincinnati Portfolio pages name current doctoral students including OBAIS students David Rea and Rui Sundrup, without degree or placement facts. The UCI MSE alumni table is a complete placement list but for materials science, outside the population.
